# untwisted-exact-210.txt   (agent W4, notebook Paul/Mathematica/Gaudin/Experiments/Gaudin-untwisted-exact.wb, 2026-10-16)
# Two-site gl(3) Gaudin chain, Lambda = {2,1,0} on both sites, UNTWISTED (zeta = 0). All numbers exact: integers, rationals p/q (Wolfram InputForm), no Sqrt anywhere.
# FORMAT: one record per line, TAB-separated fields; the first field is the tag; every other field is a Wolfram InputForm expression (nested braces = lists, p/q = rational) without spaces. Lines starting with # are comments.
# GT basis (one site): the notebook ps[{Lambda}] order = Reverse[Sort[Gelfand-Tsetlin patterns]]; index 1 is the highest-weight pattern. Record GTBASIS lists the patterns {{l1,l2,l3},{m1,m2},{k}}; WEIGHTS1 the one-site weight (E11,E22,E33 eigenvalues) per index; GMET1 the invariant diagonal metric G (G[[1]]=1; E_ij^T G = G E_ji, the GT matrices are NOT Hermitian).
# Two-site product basis: index (i,j) -> (i-1)*DIM + j, i = site-1 GT index (slow), j = site-2 index (fast); site 2 = highest weight is j = 1. Generators are the plain GT matrices (E_ij, i<j raising); inner product <a,b>_G = Sum g_i g_j a b.
# Laurent data convention: S2 = Sum_s [H_s/(u-th_s) + c2/(u-th_s)^2], S3 = Sum_s [b_s/(u-th_s) + a_s/(u-th_s)^2] (untwisted: no constant, no triple pole), c2 = lam2(lam1+1). Scaling: H_s = eta_s/th12, a_s = alpha_s/th12, b_s = beta_s/th12^2, th12 = th1 - th2, with eta, alpha, beta theta-independent (verified at three theta points). THETA below is the reference point th = (2/7,-3/5), th12 = 31/35.
# Pair notation (x0,x1) = x0 + x1*Sqrt[D0] (D0 squarefree integer; D0 = 0 means rational, x1 = 0).
# RECORDS: REP {l1,l2,l3} | DIM | GTBASIS | WEIGHTS1 | GMET1 | THETA | NSECTORS | CAS1 cas2(Lam) cas3(Lam) | SECTOR mu mult wspace-dim dimV_mu cas2(mu) cas3(mu) |
#   HWBASIS mu k {{idx,val},...} (canonical rational HW kets = primitive integer vectors, RowReduce order; k = 1..mult) | GRAM mu {{..}} (exact G Gram matrix of the HWBASIS kets) | LAURMAT mu A1 A2 B1 B2 eta1 (theta12-scaled m x m matrices acting as X.H = H.M on the HWBASIS kets: column j = image of ket j) |
#   BRANCH mu copy D0 vec gnorm2 cg eta alpha beta :  vec = {{idx,vA,vB},...} nonzero entries of the HW vector vA + Sqrt[D0]*vB (unnormalised, first nonzero component positive); gnorm2 = pair (exact G-norm^2); cg = {{nu,cA,cB},...} the site-1 GT index nu slice of the vector at site-2 index 1, i.e. the unnormalised CG coefficients <e_nu (x) e_1|Psi0>; normalised C_nu = (cA + Sqrt[D0] cB)/Sqrt[gnorm2];
#   eta, alpha, beta = {pair for s=1, pair for s=2} theta12-scaled Laurent data of the branch; branch copies in a multiplicity-2 sector are the eigenvectors of S3c[1,2] (copy 1 = smaller alpha_1).

# ---- PART 2 (appended): exact degenerate perturbation theory in eps, zeta = eps*phi, theta = (2/7,-3/5), theta12 = 31/35 (adjoint only) ----
# E4_SERIES mu copy D0 phi nmax {H1,H2} {a1,a2} {b1,b2} : H_s(eps) = Sum_n eps^n H_s^(n) etc. for the HW-limit branch of the twisted family (branch = eigenvector of the commuting family tending to the HW state BRANCH mu copy of part 1); each list has nmax+1 pairs {p,q} (order n = 0..nmax). Exact: H1+H2 = Sum_{i!=j} phi_i mu_j at order 1 only; b_s = a_s (H_s - a_s)/3 order by order (adjoint no-log relation, c2 = 3).
# E4_SYMBOLIC mu copy D0 name {order0,order1,...,order3} : the same series with symbolic phi = (p1,p2,p3) as Wolfram InputForm strings (name = H1,H2,a1,a2,b1,b2; Sqrt[5] etc. appear only for the octet copies).
# theta scaling (verified exactly): H^(n) and a^(n) scale as theta12^(n-1), b^(n) as theta12^(n-2).
# E4_PSI mu copy D0 phi nmax ell psi0 psi1 ... : Psi(eps) = Sum eps^n Psi_n in sector coordinates (the product-basis indices SECIDX of weight mu), intermediate normalisation ell.Psi_n = 0 (n>=1), Psi_0 = the BRANCH vector restricted to the sector; entries are pairs {p,q}; G-norm^2 series of Psi in E4_GNORM (pairs); the normalised branch is Psi/Sqrt[gnorm2].
# E5_KB mu copy kB lead gnorm0 (strings; Sqrt[D0] appears for the octet copies) : <x0^G|Psi_B> = eps^(2+kB) lead/Sqrt[gnorm0] + ..., lead = <x(phi) (x) x(phi)|Psi_kB> (string, symbolic phi), x0^G = x(zeta) (x) x(zeta) with x from XVEC.
# E5_SLICE mu copy n slice : Psi_n at product index (nu,1), nu = 1..DIM (strings, symbolic phi); E5_GF mu copy n poly : chat <phi_u (x) e1|Psi_n> as a polynomial in w1,w1' (o1,o2) and phi (strings), chat = (p2-o1)(p3-o1)^2(p2-o2)(p3-o2)^2(p1-p2)^2.
# XVEC {x_nu(z1,z2,z3)} : the one-site covector x(zeta) = e1^T P_phys^(G -1) (strings), x0^G = x(zeta) (x) x(zeta), homogeneous of degree lam2 in zeta.
